items.name: LudoBird
items.description: The arena anchor that started it all. Famous for its crispy Provencal Fried Chicken Sandwich served on a plush bun, alongside a newly introduced Plant-Based Ludo Sando that matches the original's crunch beat-for-beat.

items.name: Ludobab
items.description: Chef Ludo’s nod to the Mediterranean street food of his youth. This is the arena's premier destination for clean eating, serving up Grilled Pita Burgers, charred kabob bowls, and scratch-made hummus with warm pita.

items.name: Dirt Dog
items.description: An authentic, Los Angeles-bred street food icon. Their Elote Dog is legendary: a premium snap-casing frank wrapped in bacon, heavily blanketed in street corn, cotija cheese, cilantro, and chili powder.
